summary: A 1963 International Derrick fire tower on the White Mountain Apache Reservation, listed as inactive by the register though the tower still stands.

facts.design: International Derrick brand tower with a 7' x 7' metal cab
facts.status_note: The register lists it as inactive. The Fire Lookout Association still lists the structure as standing.

access.note: On the White Mountain Apache Reservation. No public visiting information found. Ask the White Mountain Apache Tribe before going; this level is my judgment from the reservation location, not a source statement.

visit.trail_note: 1967 survey directions from Heber: southwest on State Highway 160 about 14 miles to Rim Road, east on Rim Road 11.1 miles, then south 2.4 miles. The directions may be out of date.

events.note: Constructed in 1963 as an International Derrick brand fire tower
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description calls it a 100 ft steel tower with a 7 ft x 7 ft cab

evidence.supports: only International Derrick brand fire tower on the reservation; one of the newest; built 1963
evidence.quote: The only International Derrick brand fire tower on the White Mountain Apache Indian Reservation, Buckskin Lookout is also one of the newest, being constructed in 1963.

evidence.quote: Now in inactive status, the 82' metal tower with 7' x 7' cab will be transferred to the National Historic Lookout Register in 2013 when it is 50 years old.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Fire Lookout Association marks the structure Standing, while the register lists the tower as inactive. Both listings can be true.

notes_for_editor: Height conflict is unresolved: the register says 82 ft, the 1967 Coast and Geodetic Survey description (via Kemnow) says 100 ft. The register also says the tower 'will be transferred' to the register in 2013, which contradicts its own January 31, 2002 registration date; treated as stale text, not used. Present-day status and public access are unknown. The access level 'permission' is my judgment from the reservation location, not a source statement. The 1967 directions may be out of date. Searches for a tribal permit process found nothing. No new photos found. The Fire Lookout Association's managed-unit table, which a search snippet said lists Buckskin as Inactive with a 1963 date, could not be reached in the time budget, so it is not cited.
